title: Question for you all
author: Braunb8888
selftext:
So I’ve got a full trailer ready to go, but the problem is steam doesn’t approve a page for 15-30 days. I’m dying to get your thoughts on it, but at the same time, I don’t want to waste any good publicity it could drum up when I have nowhere to send people for the game.

So what do I do? Just fine tune my demo so that it’s ready to go when the steam page is up? Post little clips to get interest? What’s your approach? Steam Next Fest is the goal for me, and that cutoff is January 10th so I should be able to make it.
